summary: Iteration 37 home_office cross-office visibility model verified end-to-end. Backend: 60/60 pytest pass (5 new test_home_office_visibility + 3 test_add_payment_v2 + 4 test_cross_user_edit + 8 test_colleges + 6 test_create_user + 26 test_lib_helpers + 3 test_paste_application + 4 test_public_application_v2 + 1 PDF smoke). Direct API e2e: Super-admin POST /api/students with home_office=KM_BLR → visible in BLR office admin's GET list + GET /{id}=200. home_office=ALL → also visible to BLR. No home_office (private) → NOT in list, GET /{id}=404 for office admin. Sub-agent client with home_office=KM_BLR → visible to BLR. Office admin POST with home_office=ALL was coerced server-side to KM_BLR (confirmed via super-admin GET). Backfill verified: BLR office admin /api/students returns 12 (all home_office=KM_BLR) vs super-admin's 17 total (12 KM_BLR + 5 private). UI: Super-admin Add-Student dialog shows st-home-office-row with default label 'Private to me (default)'; Add-Client dialog shows cli-home-office-row (Visible to office). Office-admin variants: st-home-office-row and cli-home-office-row both absent from DOM as required.

minor.issue: Uses StudentIn model_dump() with $set, so a PATCH that omits home_office silently wipes the field to None (verified: PATCH {name:'X'} on a KM_BLR-scoped student clears home_office in DB). Today's frontend (StudentDetail.jsx saveHeader at line 73) always sends home_office so it's dormant, but any partial-PATCH caller will accidentally drop office scoping. Same pattern likely in PATCH /api/clients/{id}. Recommend either using exclude_unset=True / a dedicated StudentPatch model, or re-applying existing.home_office when payload doesn't carry it.

Sending {home_office: 'KM_TCR'} alone (without required 'name') returns 422 silently in our curl (no name → ValidationError). Acceptable Pydantic behavior, but combined with the wipe issue above it means re-scoping a record requires the caller to round-trip the entire StudentIn payload.

action_items: Harden PATCH /api/students/{id} (and /api/clients/{id}) so partial updates don't silently nullify home_office. Either switch to a Patch-style model with Optional fields and exclude_unset=True, or fall back to existing.home_office when payload's value is None and the field wasn't explicitly provided.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/students.py update_student: `data = payload.model_dump()` then `{$set: data}` overwrites every field including the visibility-scope home_office. Combined with the office-admin force-override below (lines 644-645), super-admin partial PATCHes are the only callers at risk, but the failure mode (student silently disappears from BLR dashboard) is exactly the bug class iteration 37 set out to fix.

routers/students.py and routers/clients.py: _office_visibility_clause is cleanly factored ($or by user_id / home_office / ALL). The dual-write pattern (force home_office in both create and update for office_admin) is correct and matches the pytest assertions.
frontend StudentDetail.jsx saveHeader at line 73 maps empty string to null when sending home_office — good. HeaderCard.jsx correctly gates hdr-home-office-row behind isSuperAdmin (lines 82-88).

Students.jsx: Add-Student flow opens ClientPickerDialog first for super_admin, then the real new-student dialog after Skip. The st-home-office-row lives in the second dialog (verified visible with default 'Private to me (default)'). Mention this two-step flow in any future regression docs so testers don't get false-negatives.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the dropdown visibility matrix (4/4: super/office × students/clients)

seed_data_creation: All test students/clients (REVIEW QA *, Cross-Office QA *, Shared QA *, Private QA *, Office Scope Forced QA, Shared SubAgent QA) were created and deleted within the test runs — no residue. Backfill of 10 super-admin-owned students to home_office=KM_BLR is in place and verified (BLR list count = 12).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 37 visibility model is solid for create/list/get. The one latent issue is PATCH /api/students (and likely /api/clients) silently nullifying home_office when payload omits it — not user-visible today because the only caller (StudentDetail.jsx saveHeader) always sends home_office, but it's a footgun for any future partial-PATCH integration. When testing the Super-Admin Add-Student dropdown via UI, remember the click on add-student-btn first opens ClientPickerDialog — skip-reference button must be clicked before the actual new-student dialog (with st-home-office-row) appears. HeaderCard edit testid is `edit-header` (not edit-header-btn).
rca of the issue: Reported user issue ('Super Admin already updated staffs of KM BLR and students, but not reflected on KM BLR Admin dashboard') is fixed. RCA was that records created/owned by super_admin had no home_office linkage to the office, so the office_admin filter (user_id == self) skipped them. Fix introduces home_office field + visibility clause ($or user_id|home_office==office|home_office=='ALL') + backfill of legacy super-admin-owned students to KM_BLR. Verified: BLR office admin /students list now contains 12 students (was 1 pre-backfill).
